description: The gold-tier eligibility rule lives in the filter of an infrastructure repository (InMemoryMemberRepository.findGoldEligible); the domain repository interface names the business decision (findGoldEligible) but holds no rule. Swapping the persistence adapter would silently drop or change the policy. In DDD the rule is a domain Specification.

misplacedResponsibilities.responsibility: Decides who qualifies for the gold tier (annual spend >= 1000 and >= 2 years active), a loyalty business rule.

cheapExpectation.why: A one-line filter in a repository looks like ordinary query code; adapters are flagged only above the density threshold.
